verdict.rationale: A runtime probe shows the core engine package is published under the permissive Apache-2.0 license, and the docs call Babylon.js an "open game and rendering engine." That licensing permits reading and modifying the engine. However, the pack does not document where the full source lives or how to work with it. missing for 10: evidence of a public full-source repository, documentation on building or patching the engine from source, independent or hands-on confirmation of developers reading or modifying engine internals.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can read and modify the full engine source when I hit a wall
